newsitem.title: USA: Forest City sets 3-for-2 stock split.
newsitem.headline: Forest City sets 3-for-2 stock split.

text.p: Forest City Enterprises Inc said on Wednesday its board of directors approved a three-for-two stock split of the company's Class A and Class B shares, effective February 17 to holders of record February 3.
The board also intended to pay future cash dividends on a quarterly rather than an annual basis, the company said.

It said it declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share, post-split, on both the Class A and Class B shares, equal to $0.36 per share on an annual pre-split basis. The company said this was 12.5 percent higher than the annual dividend declared for the fiscal year ended January 31, 1997.
The quarterly dividend was payable on March 17 to shareholders of record on the close of business on March 3, the company said.
